lines: They Bhairavī-purification declared natural thus thus; having known Guru properly supreme-bliss-revolving.
l4.sanskrit_cite: te bhairavīyasaṃskārāḥ proktāḥ sāṃsiddhikā iti iti jñātvā guruḥ samyak paramānandaghūrṇitaḥ
